newsitem.title: INDIA: At least 20 die in India bus accident.
newsitem.headline: At least 20 die in India bus accident.

text.p: At least 20 people were killed and 15 injured when a bus plunged into a gorge in the northeastern Indian state of Meghalaya on Thursday, police said.

The accident occurred near Sohryngkham, 15 km (nine miles) from Shillong, capital of Meghalaya state. The bus was travelling to Guwahati, capital of neighbouring Assam state from Imphal, the capital of Manipur state.
The injured were taken to a hospital in Shillong.
